name: image-generation
title_zh: 把一句话变成一张图：文生图与图像编辑
tagline_zh: 说“画一只戴帽子的柴犬”就出图，说“把背景换成雪地”就改图。不用切工具、不用写参数，对话里直接完成视觉创作。
tagline_en: Say it, see it. Generate or edit images right inside the chat—no tool-switching, no parameter fiddling.
desc_en: Generate or edit images from text prompts. Use when the user asks to create, draw, design, or edit an image, illustration, photo, icon, poster, or any visual content.
why_zh: 它把“生成”和“编辑”收进同一个对话流，你描述完就能拿到结果，省去来回粘贴图片和提示词的笨拙步骤。
why_en: One continuous loop from your words to the final image—no copy-pasting prompts or shuttling between apps.
limit_zh: 只覆盖文生图和基于文本的编辑，不处理局部涂抹、图层或精细修图；生成质量取决于底层模型，复杂构图或长文本提示可能跑偏。
limit_en: Text-to-image and text-driven edits only—no inpainting, layers, or fine retouch. Output quality depends on the underlying model; complex scenes or.
